svg.title: Traditional Chinese Pagoda with Coiling Dragon in a Peaceful Garden
svg.desc: An eight-story symmetrical pagoda with curved eaves, ornate tiles, wood beams, balconies and lanterns, embraced by a graceful Chinese dragon with scales, horns, whiskers, claws, and a flowing mane. The scene includes bamboo, pine, rocks, flowers, a small pond, pathways, clouds, and mist.
